links.outcome: Reproducibility of LLM evaluator outputs across repeated runs (ICC)
links.effect: High reproducibility confirmed (ICC >0.919), with Claude-3.5 most consistent (ICC, 0.997-0.998).
links.quote: High reproducibility was confirmed (ICC >0.919), with Claude-3.5 achieving the most consistent results (ICC, 0.997-0.998).

unlisted_practices: Using LLMs with progressive chain-of-thought prompting (persona-based, error-enhanced, insight-integrated) to automatically prescreen LLM-generated documentation and reduce expert workload

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an automated chain-of-thought LLM-based evaluation framework (MEDIVAL) as a quality assurance/guardrail prescreening tool to validate LLM-generated emergency documentation against expert physician standards.

primary.practice: automated LLM-based quality evaluation and prescreening of generated documentation
